items.title: Open-Source Project Brings Full iOS 27 Virtualization to Apple Silicon
items.summaryShort: Open-Source Project Brings Full iOS 27 Virtualization to Apple Silicon. The open-Source project vphone-cli enables a full iOS 27 system to run as a virtual machine on Apple Silicon.

items.title: Presentation: From Retrieval to Reasoning: Building Production-Ready Agentic AI Systems with Knowledge Graphs
items.summaryShort: Presentation: From Retrieval to Reasoning: Building Production-Ready Agentic AI Systems with Knowledge Graphs. Cassie Shum discusses why knowledge graphs serve as a critical foundation for agentic systems.

items.title: Lambda SnapStart Comes to Container Images, Ending a Packaging Tradeoff
items.summaryShort: Lambda SnapStart Comes to Container Images, Ending a Packaging Tradeoff. AWS has extended Lambda SnapStart to container image functions, which hold up to 10 GB against 250 MB for zip archives.

items.title: One Decade of Rustls: Evolution, Benchmarks, and Future Roadmap
items.summaryShort: One Decade of Rustls: Evolution, Benchmarks, and Future Roadmap. Rustls, a Rust TLS library, marks its decade-long progression from a grassroots project to a funded open-source initiative.

items.title: Automattic confirms Mullenweg has returned as CEO after attempted ouster by board
items.summaryShort: Automattic confirms Mullenweg has returned as CEO after attempted ouster by board. Automattic says Mullenweg is back as "chairman and CEO of Automattic, with full support of the board."

items.title: OpenAI’s Sam Altman says it would be ‘ill-advised' to go public in 2026
items.summaryShort: OpenAI’s Sam Altman says it would be ‘ill-advised' to go public in 2026. While OpenAI has filed confidentially for an IPO, the company will not be going public this year, according to CEO Sam Altman.

items.title: Anthropic CEO outlines plan to slow AI development
items.summaryShort: Anthropic CEO outlines plan to slow AI development. Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman seem to agree that it's time to "pace the frontier." What would that actually look like?
